general: Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1-H3 headings to establish authority.
Use 'Inter' for all body text and UI elements for maximum readability.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for Case Numbers, FIR Numbers, and Dates.
Primary Action buttons must be sharp (rounded-sm) and high contrast (Black/White).
All dates MUST be formatted as 'dd/MM/yyyy' (Indian standard).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do NOT use gradients. Use solid colors and subtle textures.
Input fields should have a distinct border color on focus.
accessibility: Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2).
Use semantic HTML (main, section, article, aside).
motion: Use subtle transitions (duration-200) for hover states.
Avoid large sweeping animations; keep it professional and snappy.
Use 'framer-motion' for simple list entrance animations if needed.

setup: Configure Tailwind theme to match the 'colors' section exactly.
Add 'Playfair Display' and 'Inter' via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
implementation: Start with the Layout component (Sidebar + Header).
Build the Dashboard page first as it's the core value prop.
Ensure the 'Tarikh' (Hearing Date) is the most prominent element in Case cards.
Mock the SMS/WhatsApp integration with simple console logs or toast notifications.
